person: UK Department for Work and Pensions
promise: Expect the Eligibility Verification Measure to save GBP 1.2 billion by fiscal 2030-31
description: DWP announced its first Eligibility Verification Notice and forecast savings from bank-assisted benefit eligibility checks. The deadline represents the end of the stated UK fiscal year 2030-31. It is a savings forecast, not evidence that the amount has already been recovered.
evidence: The October 26 announcement identifies GBP 1.2 billion of expected EVM savings separately from the government's wider anti-fraud programme.
sources: UK Department for Work and Pensions
